cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Apologize to Reality
cards.instruction: Get someone to apologize to an object, rule, place, or idea for violating its impossible expectations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Welcome to our inn. Please apologise to the doorway for knocking after you arrived.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had to get here to knock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It expected advance notice from your knuckles. Explain that you're sorry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sorry, doorway. I did phone ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for telling the telephone first. It had to hear about its own visitor secondhand.

mechanism: A treats its returning pupil arrival etiquette as an apology exercise addressed to a doorway, converting a helpful phone call into a new breach of impossible courtesy.
confusable: Not wanting apology to the host: the object itself is the offended recipient at each step.
comparison: Chair consent/work versus doorway knowledge priority.
seedUse: D147 inn/doorway/knock/phone/secondhand; S05 taught host courtesy.
